image_description: A close-up shot of a person blowing large, complex soap bubbles. The primary subject is a cluster of iridescent bubbles in the foreground and mid-ground, exhibiting rainbow colors and reflecting the surroundings. A human face (profile) is visible on the right, blowing into a bubble wand. Hands are visible holding the wands. The background is blurred but suggests an outdoor or bright indoor setting.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundaries between merging bubbles appear slightly muddy and lack the sharp, distinct Plateau borders typical of real soap foam physics. Some internal reflections seem inconsistent with the external lighting direction.

The fingers holding the wands are somewhat indistinct and merge slightly with the plastic wands. The geometry of the wands themselves is ambiguous and lacks clear mechanical structure.
